notes: LAN multiplayer polish: each AI now picks its own algorithm, host rule changes sync live to everyone, and fast-finish and undo are disabled online so the two sides cannot diverge; fixed AI moves being dropped on clients, and fixed the Linux desktop build
notes_zh: 局域网联机打磨：每个 AI 可单独选算法（策略 / A-B / PVS 自由混搭）、房主改规则实时同步给所有人、联机禁用一键终局与悔棋（避免两端棋盘分叉）；修复 AI 落子被客户端忽略导致卡住、修复 Linux 桌面版构建失败
